prompts.label: Bodycam shooter, post-Soviet school and yard
prompts.origin: The user's words in the gen3 goal of run_mvs67gsbys67, verbatim; the goal's last sentence was the harness's own origin line
prompts.brief: Make the photorealistic bodycam FPS shooter in a post-Soviet environment in our Rust engine. Make it with animations, and more photorealistic with modern render techniques — super AAAA photorealism. Make this game multiplayer using Genex.

prompts.label: Snowy apartment courtyard in winter
prompts.origin: Held-out exterior prompt written for the release gate
prompts.brief: I want a small game where you walk around a snowy apartment courtyard in winter, late afternoon. Real snow on the ground and on the benches and parked cars, bare birch trees, an old playground, and you can go into the stairwell of one of the buildings. It should look like a photo, not a cartoon.

views.describe: The courtyard at eye height, buildings and trees in view
Within 2 m of a snowy bench or a parked car
Within 3 m of a birch trunk, looking up into the branches
Inside the stairwell at eye height

motion.describe: A 3 s first-person walk across the courtyard

transitions.describe: Walk from the courtyard into the stairwell

prompts.label: Forest hike to a lookout
prompts.origin: Held-out exterior prompt written for the release gate
prompts.brief: Make a relaxing hiking game in a thick forest. Morning sun coming through the trees, a dirt trail with roots and rocks, ferns and moss everywhere, a little stream you cross on a fallen log. I just want to walk up to the lookout at the top and enjoy the view. As real looking as possible.

views.describe: On the trail at eye height, trees on both sides
Within 2 m of ferns, moss or a tree trunk
The view from the lookout

motion.describe: A 3 s first-person walk along the trail

prompts.label: Sunny countryside village
prompts.origin: Held-out exterior prompt written for the release gate
prompts.brief: A peaceful village in the countryside on a sunny summer afternoon. Old stone houses with tiled roofs, flowers on the windows, a well in the little square, fields and trees around, chickens walking about. I walk around and can talk to a couple of villagers. As realistic as you can make it.
